created_objects.purpose: Persistent application root holding release source and the SQLite database for the vantage service
created_objects.retention_reason: Permanent infrastructure for the vantage service; removal only as part of decommissioning the service.

created_objects.purpose: Immutable release source bind-mounted read-only at /app for release 1.0.0
created_objects.retention_reason: This is the running release artifact and the rollback target for the next release. Prior release directories are pruned when two newer releases exist.

created_objects.purpose: Pinned runtime image for the vantage application
created_objects.retention_reason: Referenced directly by the running application. It was pulled with app.image.pull rather than through a temporary holder application, so no holder needs deleting.

created_objects.removal_command: ssh nas1 "midclt call -j app.stop vantage && midclt call -j app.delete vantage"

created_objects.purpose: Identity gate in front of every path of the service
created_objects.retention_reason: Mandatory identity control; removing it would expose the origin. Removed only when decommissioning, and only after DNS and ingress are removed first.

created_objects.purpose: Route public traffic to the origin through the estate tunnel
created_objects.removal_command: PUT /accounts/{account}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel}/configurations with the vantage rule removed and the catch-all still last
created_objects.retention_reason: Permanent routing for the published service.

created_objects.purpose: Public name resolution for the service
created_objects.retention_reason: Permanent public hostname. In a rollback this is removed FIRST, before ingress and Access.

created_objects.purpose: Source of record for the service
created_objects.retention_reason: Permanent source repository, created private because it is a service repository.

created_objects.purpose: Detached read-only worktree at the release commit for isolated delegated review
Headless browser verification harness (puppeteer-core) used for route, responsive and live UI checks
Live dependency probes, repository creation, source integrity manifests and release identifiers
created_objects.notes: None of these files contain secret material. cfprobe.py reads the Cloudflare credential from ~/.config/cloudflare/env at runtime and never writes or prints it.

created_objects.location: node server/index.js on 127.0.0.1:4173 and its ~/vantage/data directory
created_objects.purpose: Local verification of the release build before deployment

retention_actions.manifest_verifier_command: ssh nas1 "cd /mnt/TailsPool/vantage/releases/dcf18fae522d79cb6df0b187526e215425c04e42 && find . -type f -print0 | xargs -0 sha256sum | sed 's| \./| |' | sort" | shasum -a 256
retention_actions.notes: 47 files; per-file SHA-256 manifest compared hash-sorted against the local worktree at the release commit before the application was created. No local copy is deleted by this release.

resumable_operations.state_location: release-evidence/release-evidence.json in the repository, committed after each stage
resumable_operations.notes: Publication order is Access application -> policy -> tunnel ingress -> DNS. A retry resumes at the first stage whose live state does not match intent; each stage is verified by reading live state back from the platform API rather than from a local marker.
